messages:
maria: Massive thanks to everyone who jumped on yesterday's last-minute demo issue — infra/devops/qa all hands on deck. You saved the demo and my hairline :pray:
kevin: shoutout to @nate and @lindsey for the quick patch and the postmortem notes. that warmup bug was spicy. :fire:
nate: happy to help! repro steps were weird but fixed with an extra warmup call. pasted the quick command into the runbook for now:
```\ncurl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/serving/warmup -d '{"model":"gpt-xxl","seq":1024}'\n```
lindsey: QA blitzed the smoke tests in like 20m. team coordination = instant heroics. also, ops grabbed snacks and empanadas for the late crew — 10/10 energy :pizza:
anita: also big props to infra for the rollback plan. you made the fallback smooth so the demo looked polished. sending 🍪s to the kitchen for the oncall crew.
ops-bot: [auto] Incident INC-2025-112 resolved. Root cause: missing scheduled warmup for canary instances. Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inc-2025-112
maria: I'm throwing $80 from my appreciation fund into the "emergency donut" stash and covering the empanada tab. DM me any missed names. :heart_eyes:
kevin: can we add a tiny canary warmup check to CI? low-effort, high-impact. I'll file a tiny ticket. :spiral_note_pad:
lindsey: +1 — and adding a short blurb to the oncall rotation notes so new folks see the fix.
anita: plaque in kitchen idea still stands. humor + gratitude = morale boost :laughing: 
nate: pizza party when the patch reaches prod? my treat if it stays green for 48h :thumbsup:
maria: sold. thanks again team — lovely to work with people who actually jump in. :tada:
